title: Points with ℓ integer coordinates lie on the lattice (m+1)-skeleton
statement: Let m, ℓ ∈ ℕ, d := m + 1 + ℓ and x ∈ ℝ^d = Eucl d. If there is a set I of exactly ℓ coordinate indices with x_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ I, then x ∈ ⋃_{F ∈ LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) d} latticeFace 1 F, i.e. x lies in a closed (m+1)-face {y : z_i ≤ y_i ≤ z_i + 1 (i ∈ range α), y_i = z_i (i ∉ range α)} of the unit cubical lattice (z ∈ ℤ^d, α : Fin (m+1) ↪o Fin d).
lean_statement: ∀ (m ℓ : ℕ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), (∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ∃ k : ℤ, x i = k) → x ∈ ⋃ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ), latticeFace 1 F
